```text
import numpy as np
import os
import sys
import scipy as sp
import lumapi as lumapi
sys.path.append(os.path.dirname(__file__))
from structure_set import MDC_init_

from lumopt import CONFIG
import numpy as np
from lumopt.geometries.parameterized_geometry import ParameterizedGeometry
from lumopt.figures_of_merit.modematch import ModeMatch
from lumopt.optimization import Optimization
from lumopt.optimizers.generic_optimizers import ScipyOptimizers
from lumopt.utilities.wavelengths import Wavelengths

# 启动 Lumerical FDTD
fdtd = lumapi.FDTD("F:\\wc_312\\inverse\\base_f.fsp")

num_layers = 17
# 目标中心波长和目标FWHM
lambda0 = 453e-9
fwhm_target = 10e-9
# 将 FWHM 转为高斯 sigma
sigma = fwhm_target / (2.0 * np.sqrt(2.0 * np.log(2.0)))

# 仿真波长范围
# 要覆盖目标峰及其两侧足够宽区域
working_wavelengths = Wavelengths(start=400e-9, stop=500e-9, points=300)

# 初始厚度和边界
initial_thickness = np.array([
    100e-9 if i % 2 == 0 else 52e-9
    for i in range(num_layers)
])

bounds = [(30e-9, 150e-9)] * num_layers

# 参数扰动步长
dx = 1e-9   # 1 nm
```
